traits.name: Acute Sight
traits.text:
Faldric has advantage on Wisdom
(Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Faldric makes two attacks with either his longbow or his shortsword.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit,
range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3)
piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to
hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3)
piercing damage.
